name: 莊澤光
objective: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.
schedule:
1 Course Introduction, Research Overview, and UUS Pre-test
2 Empathic Experience of Older Adults' Physical Limitations and Sensory Decline
3 Literature Review, Daily Life Observation, and Preliminary Hypothesis Testing
4 Exploring Older Adults' Needs and Building AI Personas
5 AI-Simulated Interviews, Follow-up Questions, and Data Refinement
6 Needs Analysis, Insight Synthesis, and Preliminary Concept Prototyping
7 Stage Presentation and Review by Experts/Older Adults
8 Introduction to Age-Friendly Serious Games and Interaction Mechanisms
9 Game Planning and Interaction Logic Design
10 Introduction to Interactive Prototyping Tools and AI-Assisted Implementation
11 Functional Prototype Refinement and Interaction Optimization
12 Age-Friendly Interface Design and Interaction Pacing Adjustment
13 Peer Testing and Usability Revisions
14 Project Optimization and Outcome Integration
15 Final Production and Presentation Preparation
16 Final Exhibition, Expert Rubric Evaluation, and UUS Post-test
17~18 Group Discussion, Final Course Feedback, and Focus Group Interviews / Submission of Final Reflection Report
scorePolicy:
25% RESEARCH & EMPATHY
25% DESIGN & PROTOTYPING
上列為學生研究成果評量。

50% DELIVERY & REFLECTION
上列為學生設計成果評量與學期綜合表現。

Materials and PPT by teachers
Extend Reading:
Architecture: Form, Space, & Order. by FRANCIS D. K. CHING
Points, Line and Plane by Wassily Kandinsky
延伸教學與資源:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標:
SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
